card.name: Commas and linking words after openers
card.fires_on: Short linking words or a comma right after an introductory phrase like "For example", "In fact", "Initially" or "In effect", or a preposition after a noun such as "use of". Mostly general web prose, especially text about search engines.

modes.label: Comma after opener
modes.description: A comma following a sentence-opening phrase such as For example, In fact, Initially or In effect.
modes.example: In fact<<,>> with the advent of paid inclusion, some

modes.label: Preposition after noun
modes.description: A small word like of or on right after a noun that introduces its topic.
modes.example: immediate discontinuation<< of>> promethazine HCl, antips
